in_sanskrit.name: दिया
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Goddess of Lamps, the one who illuminates with the light of knowledge

in_marathi.name: Diya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Diya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A Diya is a traditional Hindu lamp, used for religious and spiritual practices. It symbolizes the removal of darkness and ignorance, and the illumination of knowledge and truth. The name Diya is also given to girls born during Diwali, the Hindu festival of lights.
